name: history-index-retained-memory
goal: Keep history index aggregation bounded while preserving all revision evidence.

evidence: The history index retains complete record views and focused output after writing each revision, although index aggregation needs only summaries and measurements.
The existing HistoryIndexService.build case checks archived source and media but never checks whether unused payloads remain retained or whether compact summaries preserve index results.
Existing build case fails on retained written payloads; red f221424055c7 records the exact command at c3c32fbf69.
Project only aggregation fields after writing complete revision details; preserve workload measurements and historical gaps.
Unchanged build case passes at 8ee38965ae; matching green 9c285c2e4bca uses the same profile and command.
